# frp v0.71.0 (Apache-2.0) — https://github.com/fatedier/frp/releases/tag/v0.71.0
#
# dsh-link does NOT ship the frp binaries. Download the official archives yourself and extract
# frpc/frps next to this file:
#   frp_0.71.0_windows_amd64.zip     -> vendor/frp/windows-amd64/{frpc.exe,frps.exe}
#   frp_0.71.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz    -> vendor/frp/linux-amd64/frpc
# The release also publishes frp_sha256_checksums.txt if you want to verify the archives first.
#
# Then verify what you extracted byte for byte:  node scripts/verify-vendor.mjs
# If a file is missing or does not match, check your antivirus first: the frp binaries are
# UNSIGNED, and some products (Huorong/火绒 in particular) silently block or quarantine them.
#
